title: PureSurvival
description: A DonutSMP like server with a small community, HAS SHOPS!!!
body: PureSurvival is a true vanilla-style Minecraft server built for players who want an authentic, community-driven experience. With a fully player-based economy, every item, resource, and trade is shaped by the players themselves—no artificial systems or admin interference. There are no land claims, meaning the world is completely open, encouraging trust, alliances, and emergent gameplay. Whether you choose to build hidden bases, form towns, trade goods, or venture out as a lone survivor, every decision matters. PureSurvival rewards creativity, strategy, and social interaction, creating a dynamic world where your story is entirely your own.
